title: Dynamics of nonclassicality in a generalized Tavis Cummings model with XY spin $(1/2,1)$ atomic interactions
summary: We investigate the dynamics of nonclassicality, quantified by the Wigner Yanase skew information, in generalized Jaynes Cummings (JC) and Tavis Cummings (TC) models describing light matter interactions in cavity quantum electrodynamics. We first analyze a generalized JC model consisting of a single bosonic cavity mode coupled to a spin 1 atom, focusing on the temporal evolution of nonclassicality in both the cavity field and the atomic subsystem.
